correctness.rationale: Both graphs are explicitly defined, verified six-regular with common-neighbor count two and adjacency spectrum 6,2,-2. The exact covering-time identity follows from pointwise max/min inclusion-exclusion and unique finite absorbing-set hitting equations. Fraction-free exact determinants on all 32767 proper root-containing subsets per graph and independent rational summation give a strictly positive exact rational difference in the asserted bounds. Independent backward DP over all 2^16 visited sets agrees; several killed-walk equations were separately solved using exact fraction Gaussian elimination. The included 10-file source and certificate artifacts replayed successfully.

value.rationale: Expected finite-volume cover time is a natural transport/first-passage invariant. The two canonical strongly regular networks have equal graph size, degree, common-neighbor counts and adjacency spectrum, so a rigorously certified nonzero cover-time separation identifies a higher-order history-sensitive property not determined by these statistics. The four-site first discrepancy supplies interpretable structural granularity; small magnitude is acknowledged and no broader theorem claimed.
